lambda_promenade.name: Lambda Promenade
lambda_promenade.description: The eight promoted QFEP bodies as one walkable line: icon-scale emblems in λ order on a 4.34 m rail, each rebuilding its source at that source's own default, with the λ value etched on every plinth and the F and E(S) poles at the ends. A SERIES synthesis.

relationships.finding: Eight QFEP artifacts were promoted separately in one week and four came back with the SAME finding, independently: an object whose whole claim is about a POSITION had only ever been able to draw one position. [[edge_core]] said it plainest — you cannot see that the edge is NARROW if the two things it is narrow between are never in the room — and that sentence is what this artifact is built out of. The promenade is the missing second term made architectural: the neighbours a body is a position RELATIVE TO, standing in the same room, at icon scale, in λ order, on one rail.

sources.preserved_pattern: [[preserved_pattern]] learned that φ<0 does not merely resist change, it defends a PARTICULAR order — the artifact argued that a pattern is preserved and never said which pattern, 'which is exactly the move a conservative order makes about its own conventions'. Exhibited at λ 0.00 as a 6x6 checkerboard built by its own motif=checker rule, (x + z) % 2 == 0, marked cells raised by cell_size * 0.15, in its own two materials.
sources.rigid_sculpture: [[rigid_sculpture]] learned the same thing about a made monument: five formations are five orders worth defending, and 'the absence of animation cannot be an axis, because a form that does not move and a form that does are the same photograph'. Exhibited at λ 0.05 (qfep_reactor's ORDER_LAMBDA, CRYSTALLINE by its own get_state_name) as its shipped formation=ring: octahedron core, eight prisms on a circle at radius size*0.6 each turned outward, two caps.
sources.edge_core: [[edge_core]] learned that its set_lambda() is called by NOTHING in the repository, so in all three rooms the core stands green and alive for every value of λ there is — an object that can only ever draw the answer is the contradiction of the claim it is there to make. Exhibited at λ 0.40 as station=edge: translucent shell, bright counter-core, and the orbiting ring as what a still of a GPUParticles3D ring actually is, twenty dots, seeded at its own SCATTER_SEED.
sources.qfep_reactor: [[qfep_reactor]] learned the same disease independently in a second file the same day — _connect_to_sliders() waits on a group nothing ever joins, so current_lambda has stood at 0.4 everywhere, forever. Exhibited at λ 0.40 beside edge_core as station=edge, the smooth orb with its emission-sphere cloud at the source's own 0.35-to-0.30 ratio. It also supplies this artifact's second axis: `readout`, taken whole.
sources.transforming_pattern: [[transforming_pattern]] learned that the honest axis between it and preserved_pattern — the presence or absence of time — is exactly the axis a still cannot see, and declined it on the evidence, taking `concert` instead: not whether the grid changes but WHO CHANGES WITH WHOM. Exhibited at λ 0.55 as concert=superposition photographed at phase_lock = 2.0, the phase its own bench fixture pins.
sources.fluid_form: [[fluid_form]] learned that its own declared critical_parameter was the wrong axis — 'five intensities photograph as five degrees of lumpiness, which is size wearing a name' — and that its shader had never compiled, so the one shipped room had been rendering a bare sphere. Exhibited at λ 0.65 as flux=mixed: the fixed noise_gain 1.0 / sway_gain 0.3 pair evaluated on the CPU at freeze_time = 3.0, at the source's own body radius so the noise samples the same field.
sources.random_cubes: [[random_cubes]] learned that entropy is not a property of a pile but a count of the ways it could have been, so the count does not exist until you say WHICH macrostate you are counting — and that the invisible spawn box had to be drawn, because a confined pile without its frame reads as 'a smaller pile over there, which is size wearing a name'. That lesson is why this artifact's rail is always full length. Exhibited at λ 0.85 as macrostate=uniform, chance=all, REPLAYED from its own bench seed rather than modelled.
sources.particle_chaos: [[particle_chaos]] was found HOLLOW: an @export_enum and thirty lines specifying five silhouettes, with _build_particles() constructing the unconstrained cloud regardless — a sweep would have rendered five identical frames and called the axis inert, which would have been a fact about a missing function. Implemented, its lesson is that freedom is invisible with nothing to be free FROM. Exhibited at λ 1.00 (its own header: 'λ = 1 dissolution zone') as constraint=none: the isotropic ball, modelled as a still because the source's cloud lives on the GPU.

relationships.does_not_replace: The eight originals stay placed and keep their own axes. The promenade never re-runs a member's axis from the outside — each emblem is fixed at its source's OWN default — because letting a map drive them from here would fork eight vocabularies into a ninth. This is an addition for rooms that want the comparison, not an upgrade; the walk-scale encounter with one artifact alone is still the curriculum's spine, and it is what the synthesis hides.
relationships.refused_by_a_source: [[edge_core]]'s promotion explicitly declined to share `station` with [[fluid_form]] and [[rigid_sculpture]]: 'their line is phi (resist vs embrace change) and this one's is lambda (order vs chaos)... a shared word with two vocabularies would claim a kinship the geometry does not have.' That is a refusal of exactly the composition this artifact makes. It is therefore made EXPLICITLY and marked in geometry: at readout=lattice each standing body gets a marker at its TRUE (λ, φ) and a tie-line from its slot, and four of the eight tie-lines run off the λ axis because four of these bodies are φ arguments the promenade has projected. The equal spacing is likewise a lie about λ — 0.00 and 0.05 are one slot apart, and so are 0.40 and 0.40 — and the same tie-lines say so.

dna.default: extent=full, readout=numeral. A synthesis has no shipped placements, so the default is a design choice rather than a preservation duty, and this is the strongest single reading: all eight bodies up, in λ order, on the full rail, with both poles standing and the λ number etched on every plinth. It is the only value of `extent` at which the promenade is a spectrum rather than a sample. readout=numeral is the family's legacy rung and matches qfep_reactor, line, xyz_slider_plate and qfep_calibrator; it is also the rung the exhibit needs to be honest at all, since without the numbers the equal spacing passes unchallenged.
dna.was: synthesized from preserved_pattern, rigid_sculpture, edge_core, qfep_reactor, transforming_pattern, fluid_form, random_cubes and particle_chaos — eight artifacts promoted separately between 2026-08-03 and 2026-08-04, whose cross-member argument (that they are positions relative to one another) existed only in registry notes and in one sentence of edge_core's promotion.
dna.axis_extent: WHICH STRETCH OF THE λ LINE IS STOOD UP. The rail is ALWAYS full length and the occupied band is inlaid brighter on it — random_cubes' lesson taken directly, since without the full rail a crop would read as a smaller exhibit instead of a cropped one. full = all eight, the spectrum. ordered_half = λ 0.0..0.5, the four low bodies re-spread over the same rail at twice the size, F pole standing and no E pole. edge = λ 0.3..0.5, which is is_at_edge()'s own interval — the one qfep_reactor has always tested for and never drawn — leaving two bodies on a full-length rail with NEITHER POLE in the room. dissolved_half = λ 0.5..1.0, E(S) pole only. `edge` is the value that argues: with nothing to be an edge between, the edge is not narrow, it is everything.
dna.not_an_amount: ordered_half and dissolved_half hold the SAME number of stations at the SAME size and are opposite pictures — a frozen checkerboard, a crystal and two orbs against two orbs, a wave plate, a blob, a tumbling pile and a cloud. What varies is which part, not how much. This is the failure mode fluid_form and random_cubes were both promoted around and it is checked here rather than assumed.
dna.axis_readout: TAKEN CHARACTER FOR CHARACTER from qfep_reactor — one of this artifact's own sources — and behind it commons/primitives/line/line.gd, xyz_slider_plate.gd and qfep_calibrator: the word, the four values, the strictly additive rank ladder, and the rule that an unrecognised word reads as `numeral` rather than `none` so a typo cannot strip the placard off a live room. Eight tokens carry this exact list. none = eight bodies and no numbers, the spectrum as a procession you can see the order of and cannot check. numeral = the λ value etched on each plinth and the poles lettered F and E(S). gradation = plus the public scale: the λ rule along the whole walk, teeth every 0.1, and the edge band painted across 0.3..0.5, after which the equal spacing can be caught lying. lattice = plus the λ x φ plane the formula actually lives in, the edge band as a REGION, a true-position marker for every standing body and a tie-line from each emblem to its marker.
dna.kin: The reader is LOCAL rather than a call into XYZSliderPlate.readout_name(), because qfep_reactor's is local and matching the nearest kin matters more here than saving four lines; the one honest divergence from the canon is that the canon's alias table (ticks -> gradation, integers -> lattice) is not implemented, exactly as qfep_reactor does not implement it.
dna.declined: `regime`, the corpus's 15-carrier word for which named case of a system's behaviour is on show, and the obvious candidate: bifurcation_walkway — the SAME FOLDER, the same sequence, a walkable parameter line — carries it for exactly this act ('regime crops the r axis onto one behaviour class... a cropped chart is a chart of less; a cropped corridor is twelve metres of one condition'), and its value lists are per-system on all fifteen carriers, with bouncing_ball's list-refusal already on the record. The question transfers; the values cannot. On the λ line the behaviour classes ARE ALREADY NAMED — `station` = edge|order|chaos, which edge_core and qfep_reactor share character for character precisely so the two can be checked against each other. A `regime` list here would either be those three words with a fourth bolted on, forking a two-carrier vocabulary whose whole purpose is the check, or three fresh names for the same three conditions, which is worse. So the refusal is itself the finding: this axis is deliberately NOT about condition. It asks how much of the line is present — the one question no single body standing on the line can ask, and therefore the one a synthesis is for.
dna.declined_station: `station` (edge|order|chaos) for the same reason stated the other way round: adding a fourth value to a three-value list shared by two of this artifact's own sources would break the only check those two exist to provide. The referents differ too — station is a POINT on the line, extent is an INTERVAL of it.
dna.declined_chapter: `chapter` (facade_grammar_demo plus the five particle_randomness tokens), whose note reads 'the word chapter and the leading all are facade_grammar_demo's... the chapter names belong to this book', so a per-artifact value list is explicitly licensed and the mechanism is identical — filter a roster by a named section, re-lay the survivors. Refused only because a chapter is a section of a text, and these are contiguous intervals of a continuous parameter with neighbours on both sides. `edge` is not a chapter; it is the middle of one.
dna.declined_emblem_axes: A third axis re-running the members' own axes from here. Each emblem is fixed at its source's OWN default — checker, ring, edge, edge, superposition, mixed, uniform+all, none — because a synthesis that let a map drive its members would fork eight vocabularies into a ninth, and the plan's rule is that a synthesis never replaces its sources and must keep each member's argument legible inside it.
dna.declined_time: Everything time-domain. This file has no _process at all, which is both the discipline (the evidence is one still PNG per value) and the argument: preserved_pattern and rigid_sculpture were each promoted around the fact that the ABSENCE OF TIME cannot be an axis, and a promenade of positions is the same claim at exhibition scale.
dna.still_note: NO FIXTURE IS NEEDED AND NONE IS DECLARED — there is no clock in this file to pin. Every draw is seeded by a constant: edge_core's ring at its own SCATTER_SEED 40404, qfep_reactor's cloud at its own JITTER_SEED 40405, particle_chaos's ball at 20260806. random_cubes' pile is not modelled but REPLAYED — the same fifteen draws per cube in the source's own order (size, x, y, z, three rotations, hue, saturation, then three velocity and three angular components, the last six taken so the stream cannot drift and discarded so the emblem stands still) from its own bench seed 20260804 — so that emblem is literally the pile its sweep photographs. The two time-driven sources are frozen at the phases their own fixtures pin: transforming_pattern at phase_lock 2.0, fluid_form at freeze_time 3.0, reused rather than chosen so an emblem and its source's gallery tile are the same instant of the same object.
dna.geometry_note: Predicted, not measured — the numbers a measuring pass should confirm. At the default (extent=full, readout=numeral) the AABB is about 4.58 x 0.62 x 0.44 m: rail length 4.34, poles at +/- 2.29, plinths 0.30 tall with the tallest emblems (the two orbs and the blob) reaching about 0.60, depth from the 0.44 plinths. A crop re-spreads its survivors over the SAME 4.34 m at up to 2x — capped, because uncapped extent=edge would be 4x and put a 1.76 m plinth on a 4.34 m rail, making the union box a fact about the crop's furniture — so the widest variant is still 4.34 and the extent sweep reframes NOT AT ALL. Plinth height is held constant at 0.30 under every scale, so the promenade stays level and its seating in a room is identical at every value; only emblem height moves. readout rungs 2 and 3 lie flat on the floor in FRONT at z 0.76 +/- 0.42, growing the box in depth only (to about 1.18) and never in height — qfep_reactor made the same move for the same reason. Element count at extent=full, readout=lattice is about 265 MeshInstance3D plus 10 Label3D; nothing is a MultiMeshInstance3D, so no layers = 0 anchor is needed, and nothing carries collision.
dna.measurement_risk: A 7:1 STRIP, and the framing hint is derived rather than guessed. capture_config_sweep frames radius = half the AABB DIAGONAL at PAD 1.9 and FOV 34, from YAW 0.62 / PITCH -0.26. The default box gives a diagonal of about 4.52, so the unframed view is roughly 8.6 world units square and the subject — about 4.2 x 0.86 after foreshortening — lands near 5% of frame, which is inside the too-small-to-measure band. framing 0.62 brings the view to about 5.3, putting the subject at roughly 79% of width and 16% of height, near 13% of frame, with about a tenth of the frame as margin at each end. IF THE SWEEP CLIPS THE END STATIONS, RAISE IT TOWARD 0.75 AND NEVER LOWER IT BELOW 0.55: the ends of this line are its argument, and an exhibit about what is missing from the room must not have its ends cropped by the camera. Second risk: extent=edge is DELIBERATELY the emptiest frame — two emblems, no poles — so a large drop in subject percentage there is the finding, not a fault. Read it against the rail, which is present at full length in every value and is the fixed high-contrast reference the crop is legible against.

lambda_promenade.qfep_connection: The whole equation laid out as a walk. F stands at one end and E(S) at the other, and between them the eight bodies the laboratory has already built, each restating its own claim at icon scale with its λ etched underfoot. The point is not that λ explains all eight — it does not, and the promenade says so: half of these are φ arguments that have been projected onto the λ line to make it look continuous, and at readout=lattice the tie-lines measure exactly how far each one was moved. What the walk gives back is the thing every one of these artifacts was missing alone — a second term to be read against.
